name: UKSOL UKS-S108 440W
notes: Technology: monocrystalline cells (architecture not stated), 108-cell format, monofacial with single 2.0mm glass. A single 440W entry - UKSOL's standard M10N half-cell module. Pros: nothing unusual in its electrical profile relative to other 108-cell panels generally, so it's a straightforward, easy-to-integrate choice. Cons: thinner 2.0mm single glass is only heat-strengthened rather than fully tempered (see the Guide's glass section), and there's no bifacial or premium-cell variant in this range.
